notes.title: gShift is LIVE!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that voted and helpted get us Greenlit! We're live and the game is available for the LOW LOW PRICE of $2.99 USD. 

We appreciate everyone who tries the game out and we love to hear feedback. 

We would like to acknowledge that there is a strange glitch that causes the game to crash on the Tutorial levels only, and only when you activate the portal at the end. 

The dirty way around this for now is to press ESC and simply click NEXT in the upper left hand corner to go to the next level. This hiccup is not present on the normal levels, just the tutorials. If you're brave, the Tutorials are not required, so you could simply play through the main levels and skip the Tutorials entirely.

We will release an update as fast as possible to adress this problem. Please be patient with us, and accept our humble apologies.
